why: The frozen Jest oracles must detect missing session migration, a broadened public sign-in path and disclosure of the root token as a browser cookie. Built-server expiry, revocation and transport cases remain in the Playwright acceptance suite.

mutants.why: A fresh database must reach v43 and contain the auth_sessions table.
Missing migration SQL must fail closed rather than letting later requests in.
Only the exact body-token sign-in path may bypass pre-existing browser authentication.
The deliberate URL hand-off must issue an opaque cookie and never write the operator token into it.
